extracted_claim: GLFW provides three event processing functions: glfwPollEvents (processes pending events immediately, best for continuous rendering), glfwWaitEvents (blocks until events arrive, best for editors), glfwWaitEventsTimeout (blocks with timeout, best for mixed UI/refresh).
implementation_relevance: HSE main loop must call one of these functions each frame. Currently uses glfwPollEvents in the render loop.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE already uses glfwPollEvents but source confirms the three-function pattern

extracted_claim: GLFW key input provides both callbacks (glfwSetKeyCallback) and polling (glfwGetKey). Key actions are GLFW_PRESS, GLFW_RELEASE, GLFW_REPEAT. GLFW_REPEAT is intended for text input and should not be used to drive animation. For held-key detection, use GLFW_STICKY_KEYS mode or save state from PRESS/RELEASE events.
implementation_relevance: HSE should use callbacks for reliable key detection rather than polling alone, which can miss rapid press/release sequences.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE input handling not yet implemented in detail

extracted_claim: Mouse input includes cursor position (glfwSetCursorPosCallback/glfwGetCursorPos), cursor modes (GLFW_CURSOR_NORMAL, GLFW_CURSOR_DISABLED for FPS camera, GLFW_CURSOR_HIDDEN, GLFW_CURSOR_CAPTURED), raw mouse motion (glfwRawMouseMotionSupported, GLFW_RAW_MOUSE_MOTION), mouse buttons (glfwSetMouseButtonCallback/glfwGetMouseButton), and scroll (glfwSetScrollCallback).
implementation_relevance: GLFW_CURSOR_DISABLED is the standard pattern for FPS-style camera controls. Raw mouse motion provides unscaled/unaccelerated input for precise camera control.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE has a Camera class but mouse-based camera control not yet implemented

extracted_claim: GLFW supports gamepad input via SDL_GameControllerDB mapping format. Gamepads are identified by GUID and mapped to standard Xbox-like layout with 15 buttons and 6 axes. glfwJoystickIsGamepad checks if a joystick has a gamepad mapping. glfwGetGamepadState retrieves mapped button/axis state.
implementation_relevance: HSE can support gamepad input by leveraging GLFW's built-in SDL_GameControllerDB mappings rather than implementing custom mapping.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: Gamepad support not yet in HSE
